release_notes: LiveChat Links tab rebuilt per spec. Support Links now only Status Page (configurable URL); removed Main Site / WHM Panel / Admin Panel / Billing Portal / GitHub. External Tools: Google Analytics and Google Search Console now have code fields that generate a ready-to-copy embed/meta snippet (with Copy button), and Cloudflare Dashboard + SSL Server Test URLs are configurable. Social Media: each channel (Twitter/X, Facebook, Instagram, Discord, YouTube) now has an Enable toggle + URL field for linkback on the customer site, persisted to automation_settings.livechat_social_links. Removed the Chat History card entirely (Closed Chats / All Chats / Export / Visitor History were 404s). Added POST /admin/livechat/links route + saveLinks() handler. Verified live: save persists GA code, GSC meta, status URL and social JSON.
